lines.text: Many learners say: I eat medicine every day.
Better: I take medicine every day.
Take! I take medicine in the morning.

native.tip: 中文说“吃药”，所以很多人说 eat medicine。英语里药要搭配 take，不用 eat。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “I eat medicine every day.”😅 中文“吃药”，英语要用 take：“I take medicine every day.”跟着 Carlos 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“I take medicine every day.”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: Chinese says “eat medicine”, but in English medicine goes with take.
